given: A script under business/scripts keeps the repository path of its old name as a literal drive-letter path (C:\flow-ir\...), while business/config declares a different root.
when: The path-origin gate scans the business layer.

expected.side_effects: the gate names the file and the line of the frozen path and stops the run; it does not rewrite the path for anyone

trigger.sandbox: the shape is built under the system temp directory by tests/gate-cases.Tests.ps1; nothing is written under the repository's business\

why: A drive-letter path outlives the repository rename it was written for: the code keeps pointing at a directory that no longer exists, and no runtime gate notices because nothing else reads the script's own strings.
